(x) => ({ key: x.id, main: x.id + ' · ' + x.f, sub: x.u + ' · ' + x.d, right: right(x.s, (/refund|Debit|Fee/i.test(x.f) ? '−' : '+') + mny(x.a)), onPress: () => open('inv', x.id) })

callSites.callee: db.INV.filter((x) => x.rq || x.s === 'Refunded' || x.s === 'Refund pending' || x.ref).map
arguments: (x) => ({ key: x.id, main: x.id + ' · ' + x.u, sub: x.rq ? 'Requested ' + mny(x.rq) + ' of ' + mny(x.a) : 'Refunded ' + mny(x.ref || x.a), right: right(x.rq ? 'Pending' : x.s === 'Refunded' ? 'Refunded' : 'Refund pending', 'navigate'), onPress: () => open(x.rq ? 'rfd' : 'inv', x.id) })
(s, i) => ({ key: s[0], main: s[0], sub: s[1] + ' · ' + s[2], right: right(s[4], mny(s[3])), onPress: () => open('stl', String(i)) })
(s, i) => ({ key: s[0], main: s[0], sub: s[1], right: right(s[3], mny(s[2])), onPress: () => open('pay', String(i)) })
(r, i) => ({ key: r.id, main: r.id + ' · ' + r.t, right: right(r.st, 'navigate'), onPress: () => open('rec', String(i)) })
